sloka: अद्य अहम् मार्गणैः प्राणान् आदास्ये जीवितांतगैः ।सलिले क्षीरम् आसक्तम् निष्पिबन् इव सारसः ॥३-१९-८॥
transliteration: adya aham mārgaṇaiḥ prāṇān ādāsye jīvitāṁtagaiḥ ।salile kṣīram āsaktam niṣpiban iva sārasaḥ ॥3-19-8॥

translations.english: Just as the swan drinks only milk from water (mixed with milk), my arrows will (unerringly) drain the life from the enemy's body right now.
